# netcup_scp_access_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Exchanges a netcup SCP refresh token for a short-lived access token. The result is not stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "netcup_scp_access_token" "token" {
  refresh_token = var.netcup_scp_refresh_token
}

provider "netcup" {
  scp_access_token = ephemeral.netcup_scp_access_token.token.access_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Offline refresh token for the netcup SCP REST API.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client_id. Defaults to `scp`.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth2 token endpoint. Defaults to the netcup SCP Keycloak token endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Short-lived bearer access token.
- `expires_in` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds.
- `token_type` (String) Type of token, typically `Bearer`.
